[TOC]

### Prerequisites
Remote control configuration:
- Available remote control, normal display screen

Platform configuration:
- The device has been registered on the platform
- An account with parameter configuration permission and installed client

###Operation steps
####Use the remote control display menu to open

1. Press the remote control [ENTER] key to enter the login interface, enter the password "999999", and automatically log in to the main menu
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d21340dd380b78d93ca5bb49cde9b78a)

2. Select [Settings] in the main menu interface and press the "ENTER" key to enter the settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c7ba20e0047cb02d6ad17fdc148faa3f))

3. Select [Alarm] in the [Settings] interface, and press the "ENTER" key to enter the alarm settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3aa8e8d6771e810adae8cae455fbad80)
4. In the [Alarm Settings] interface, press the right arrow key to come to the [Acceleration] interface, press the "ENTER" key to enter the editing state, press the down arrow key to move to the Enable checkbox, check Enable, and confirm to save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=11f49412adebdd773381edf40551a09b)

####Platform sends command to start
1. Log in to the platform client with an account and use the client plug-in to send a command to start. For usage, refer to [Tongtianxing Client Plug-in Online Configuration Tool](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/web/#/13/104 "Tongtianxing Client Plug-in Online Configuration Tool")

2. Copy the following command in the input box and click "Set Parameters". After completion, remotely restart the device to take effect.
 ```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stOSD ucFD_GSensorEnable="1" /></VariCfgSec>
```
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=afacd4b04b72ef4da336c8d9a1389b2a)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8ba8b9bc95b62ca501a31e179556675a)

####Dynamic calibration after turning on
1. Turn on this function first, connect the GPS antenna to make it locate successfully
2. Drive the vehicle to a flat road and drive straight at a speed of more than 20KM/H, and keep driving for more than 10s
3. Brake slightly and step on the emergency brake to complete the calibration. After the calibration is successful, you can check the status on the display or listen to the voice prompt (prerequisite to import this voice package)
Show Mtn ACC Calibrated means calibration is successful
Displaying Stn ACC Calibrated means calibration is not successful
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=04168a177fcd1ea87e176697c38194d2)
####Description of each alarm field
Rollover: rollover
Overturn: rollover
Front Impact: collision
Rear Impact: rear-end collision (by the rear vehicle)
Left Impact: left collision
Right Impact: right collision
Harsh Acceleration: rapid acceleration
Harsh Braking: rapid braking
Left Harsh Cornering: sharp left turn
Right Harsh Cornering: sharp right turn
